scripts.build:form: ng build ngu-form && node projects/ngu-form/schematics/build.mjs && node projects/docs-kit/agents/generate.mjs projects/demo/agent-docs.json --package dist/ngu-form
scripts.build:dropdown: ng build ngu-dropdown && node projects/docs-kit/agents/generate.mjs projects/ngu-dropdown-demo/agent-docs.json --package dist/ngu-dropdown
scripts.api:update: node projects/docs-kit/api/api.mjs dist/ngu-form --report api --docs projects/demo/src/app/docs/content/reference && node projects/docs-kit/api/api.mjs dist/ngu-dropdown --report api && node projects/docs-kit/api/api.mjs dist/ngu-table --report api
scripts.api:check: node projects/docs-kit/api/api.mjs dist/ngu-form --report api --docs projects/demo/src/app/docs/content/reference --check && node projects/docs-kit/api/api.mjs dist/ngu-dropdown --report api --check && node projects/docs-kit/api/api.mjs dist/ngu-table --report api --check
